stem: The author develops the thesis of the selection mainly by —

options.label: A
options.text: alternating both descriptions and specific examples of food forests with more general information about the reasons behind creating edible forests

options.label: B
options.text: describing a typical day of the food forest coordinator and then explaining how edible forests are primarily funded

options.label: C
options.text: providing a general overview of where edible forests are located and then describing why it is important to have volunteers who are knowledgeable about the care of plants

options.label: D
options.text: listing the requirements residents must meet before foraging in the edible forests and then offering specific examples as to where most edible forests are located
